description: This file defines the TenantProfileService class, which provides methods for managing tenant profiles via HTTP requests in an Angular application. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and setting default tenant profiles, as well as fetching profile info and profiles by IDs.

classes.name: TenantProfileService
classes.description: Angular service class for managing tenant profiles through HTTP API calls.

methods.name: getTenantProfiles
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of tenant profiles.

methods.name: getTenantProfile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tenant profile by ID.

methods.name: saveTenantProfile
methods.description: Saves a tenant profile (create or update).

methods.name: deleteTenantProfile
methods.description: Deletes a tenant profile by ID.

methods.name: setDefaultTenantProfile
methods.description: Sets a tenant profile as the default.

methods.name: getDefaultTenantProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about the default tenant profile.

methods.name: getTenantProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info for a specific tenant profile.

methods.name: getTenantProfileInfos
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of tenant profile info objects.

methods.name: getTenantProfilesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple tenant profiles by their IDs and sorts them accordingly.
